learning_outcomes.text: The student taking the course will know the features that a product or service must have in order to be successful in the market, and will be able to make a feasibility and business plan based on the product or service. Will be able to design the workflow and the organization required by this flow; be able to make quality planning in supply, production, marketing, cash flow, organization and all processes, and revise the product and plan according to changing conditions; In short, in addition to engineering formation, he/she will gain the basic qualities of acting like a successful businessman.

syllabus_topics: Developments in Science and Technology from Past to Present, Examples of Scientific and Technological Developments from the World and Turkey, Transition from Industrial Society to Knowledge Society.

Classical Industry, Advanced Technology, and R&D Dimension, What is Innovation? What are the types of Innovation? Examples, Is Innovation the same as Creativity? What are the distinguishing features of Innovation from R&D? Country examples in Innovation, Intellectual Property Rights and Our Innovation Policy, Innovation in the Public Sector.

Entrepreneurship and its rules, SME Definition, Incentive Law, State Support and Incentives and the institutions providing them; (KOSGEB, TÜBİTAK, İŞKUR, Ministry of Science, Industry and Technology, Ministry of Development, Treasury Undersecretariat, Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Agriculture).
Technology Development Zones, Organized Industrial Zones, Technoparks, What needs to be done.
bibliography: Kotler, P. , Kotler on Marketing, Free Press (1999).
Cosby, P. B. , Quality and Me, Jossey-Bass (1999).
Porter, M. E. On Competition, Harvard Business School Press (2008).
